title: Locating NSW public schools and the enrolment process
summary: Find information and enrolment details for public preschools, primary, and secondary schools in NSW.
intro:
In NSW, every child in the state is entitled to enrol in a government school, provided:

*Designated areas for accepting enrolments do not apply to preschools.

The department responsible for public schools (state schools) is the NSW Government Department of Education.
who_can_apply: Every child in NSW is entitled to enrol in a government school.
For preschools, designated areas for accepting enrolments do not apply.
what_you_need: Proof of identity (commemorative birth certificates are not acceptable).
Completed Expression of interest form for a NSW public preschool.
Knowledge of the desired level of schooling (primary or secondary) and the enrolment area.

faqs.q: Who is responsible for public schools in NSW?
faqs.a: The NSW Government Department of Education is responsible for public schools (state schools).

faqs.q: When can I enrol my child in a public preschool?
faqs.a: You can enrol your child at the beginning of the school year if they turn 4 on, or before, 31 July that year.

faqs.q: What is required to enrol in a public preschool?
faqs.a: You must complete the PDF form Expression of interest to enrol in a NSW public preschool, and all enrolment forms must be completed in English.
